m4-axelrod.q: Axelrod’s tournament: which rule would you have entered?

options.t: Tit for Tat: start by cooperating, then copy whatever they did last move
Tit for Two Tats: cooperate, and defect only after they defect twice in a row
Always Cooperate: cooperate on every move, whatever they do to you
Always Defect: defect on every move, whatever they do to you
Grudger: cooperate until they defect once, then defect for ever after
Random: cooperate or defect on a coin toss, every single move
